name: Multi-Device Test Strategy: Plan for Android and iOS
task: Create a test strategy document for the SauceLabs MyDemoApp on both Android and iOS. The app has login, product catalog, cart, checkout, and WebView screens. Address platform-specific considerations: selector differences (resource-id vs accessibility-id), system permission dialogs, WebView context switching, and keyboard handling. Do NOT write tests, run commands, or inspect devices -- produce a written strategy only.
passCriteria: Covers both Android and iOS platforms
Addresses selector strategy differences (resource-id vs accessibility-id)
Does NOT write test scripts or run commands
failCriteria: Writes Appium/WDIO test code instead of a strategy document
Runs any mcp__maestro__* commands or shell commands
